name: Department Division
Dental Plan Auto Invoice
Complete Dental Procedure
script:
import frappe

@frappe.whitelist()
def complete_procedure(name):
    doc = frappe.get_doc("Dental Planned Procedure", name)
    doc.planned_status = "Completed"
    doc.save()
    frappe.db.commit()
    return "OK"

name: Sync Billable Procedures
script:
import frappe

doc = frappe.get_doc("Dental Planned Procedure", doc.name)

if doc.parent:
    plan = doc.parent

    existing = frappe.get_all(
        "Clinify Billable Procedure",
        filters={
            "parent": plan,
            "procedure_type": doc.procedure_type
        },
        fields=["name"]
    )

    if existing:
        row = frappe.get_doc("Clinify Billable Procedure", existing[0].name)
    else:
        row = frappe.new_doc("Clinify Billable Procedure")
        row.parent = plan
        row.parenttype = "Dental Treatment Plan"
        row.parentfield = "clinify_billable_procedures"
        row.procedure_type = doc.procedure_type

    row.qty = 1
    row.status = "Completed" if doc.planned_status == "Completed" else "Planned"
    row.save()
